posts.coverText: 5 sweet questions to ask your girlfriend (the last one is a trap)

slideText.text: If your mom asked, “Why him?” what would you say?
If we broke up tomorrow, what’s one little thing about me you’d miss the most?
What’s something I do that used to annoy you but now secretly makes you smile?
What’s something you tell your friends you love about me but never actually tell me?
If I promised not to get mad, what’s one thing you wish I’d change about myself?

posts.coverText: If we got married tomorrow... would we actually last?

slideText.text: Would you be upset if I kept my last name?
options: Yeah — we’re supposed to share a last name.
A little, but I’d get over it.
No — it’s your name.
I’d take yours instead.

slideText.text: Who’s making breakfast on our first morning as a married couple?
options: Me — you’re getting breakfast in bed.
You — I’m sleeping in.
Both of us — marriage is 50/50.
My mom {EM} she already invited us over.

slideText.text: What’s the first thing you’d expect to change after we got married?
options: We combine our bank accounts.
No more vacations without each other.
We start trying for a baby.
Nothing — marriage is just a piece of paper.

posts.coverText: Guys, ask your girlfriend these 5 questions. don’t argue with her answers 👀

slideText.text: What did you really think of me when we first met?
options: Cute, but a little full of yourself
Sweet, but painfully awkward
I thought you were a total player
Honestly? I wasn’t attracted to you

slideText.text: What surprised you most once we started dating?
options: You’re way more sensitive than you let on
You remember things I forgot I told you
You get jealous but pretend you don’t
You fell harder than I did

slideText.text: What’s something you used to find annoying about me but secretly love now?
options: How clingy you can get
Your nonstop teasing
How you turn everything into a competition
How brutally honest you are

slideText.text: What’s my biggest red flag as a boyfriend?
options: You get defensive instead of listening
You shut down when we argue
You turn serious conversations into jokes
You’re a little too friendly with other girls

slideText.text: Knowing everything you know now, would you still go on that first date with me?
options: Without a second thought
Yes, but I’d take things slower
Only if a few things about you changed
Honestly? I don’t think I would

slideText.text: We leave the bathroom door open when we pee.
options: normal
weird

slideText.text: We sleep in the same bed but use separate blankets.
options: normal
weird

slideText.text: We’ve been together for two years and still haven’t farted in front of each other.
options: normal
weird

slideText.text: We have each other’s phone passcodes.
options: normal
weird

slideText.text: We split the bill 50/50 on every date. No exceptions.
options: normal
weird

posts.coverText: 5 sweet questions to ask your girlfriend (but #5 might hurt)

slideText.text: If someone asked what made you fall for me, what would you say?
What’s one thing about me you hope never changes, even 10 years from now?
What’s a little thing I do that makes you feel loved more than I realize?
What’s something about me you wouldn’t put up with in another guy?
If you could go back to the day we met, knowing everything you know about me now, would you still choose me?
